branchStatuses.rationale: At least one rule must score successfully.
Activation-required benefits must not silently score.
Enrollment-required benefits must not silently score.
Exhausted capped rewards must not drive recommendations.
Portal-only rules must reject incompatible channels.
Merchant-specific rules must reject other merchants.
Category rules must reject other categories.
Capped rules need an unused-cap scenario.
Purchases that exceed remaining cap need coverage.
Statement credit unused state must be covered.
Statement credit partial state must be covered.
Credit clipping below purchase amount must be covered.
Credit clipping above purchase amount must be covered.
Base earning is the fallback path.
Rotating category rewards need explicit branch coverage.
High confidence branch must be present.
Medium confidence branch must be present.
Low confidence branch must be present.
Normal ranking path must be covered.
Future effective-date boundary must be covered.
